HOME_WHAT_IS_DESC: Tarhana is a traditional fermented soup made from yogurt, grains and vegetables. Slowly prepared for depth of flavor, it has a warm, savory taste with a gently tangy finish — then dried so it can be cooked in just a few minutes.
HOME_PREPARE_INTRO: Our fermented soup mix is at its best as a warm, rich soup. Start with the classic — then top to taste.
HOME_PREPARE_STEP1: 1. Boil 250 ml of water per 2 tablespoons of soup mix.
HOME_PREPARE_STEP2: 2. Whisk in the soup mix and simmer for 5–10 minutes until smooth and creamy.
HOME_PREPARE_STEP3: 3. Serve warm with olive oil, herbs, black pepper or a dollop of yogurt.
HOME_RECIPES_CTA_DESC: Tarhana can also be used in sauces, bowls and simple weekday meals.

RECIPES_FEATURED_DESC: A warm, savory and gently tangy soup made from naturally fermented soup mix. Ready in minutes and easy to finish with olive oil, herbs or yogurt.
RECIPES_CARD1_DESC: The essential recipe — warm, simple and comforting.
RECIPES_CARD1_INGREDIENTS: 2-3 tbsp fermented soup mix, 250ml water (per serving), 1 tbsp olive oil or butter, salt to taste.
RECIPES_CARD1_STEPS: Whisk soup mix into cold water. Bring to a boil while stirring constantly. Simmer for 5-10 minutes until smooth. Season to taste.
RECIPES_CARD1_SERVING: Serve warm with a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of dried mint or chili flakes.
RECIPES_CARD2_DESC: A richer version finished with yogurt, herbs and olive oil.
RECIPES_CARD2_INGREDIENTS: 2-3 tbsp fermented soup mix, 200ml water, 50ml yogurt or cream, 1 clove garlic, butter.
RECIPES_CARD2_STEPS: Mix soup mix and water in a pot. Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 mins. Whisk in yogurt or cream at the end. Sauté minced garlic in butter separately until golden.
RECIPES_CARD2_SERVING: Swirl the garlic butter into the soup and top with fresh dill or parsley.
RECIPES_CARD3_DESC: Made with vegetable broth for a deeper, savory flavor.
RECIPES_CARD3_INGREDIENTS: 2-3 tbsp fermented soup mix, 250ml vegetable broth, 1/2 cup finely diced seasonal vegetables, olive oil.
RECIPES_CARD3_STEPS: Sauté diced vegetables in olive oil until soft. Add vegetable broth and whisk in the soup mix. Simmer for 10 minutes until vegetables are tender.
RECIPES_CARD3_SERVING: Finish with a squeeze of fresh lemon and chopped parsley.
RECIPES_CARD4_DESC: A savory, tangy loaf using the soup mix as a seasoning base.
RECIPES_CARD4_INGREDIENTS: 500g flour, 3-4 tbsp fermented soup mix, 7g dry yeast, 350ml warm water, 1 tsp salt.
RECIPES_CARD4_STEPS: Mix flour, soup mix, yeast and salt. Gradually add warm water and knead for 10 minutes. Let rise in a warm place for 1 hour. Bake at 200°C for 30-35 minutes.
RECIPES_CARD4_SERVING: Serve warm with salted butter or as an accompaniment to soup.
RECIPES_CARD5_DESC: Quick and savory snacks with a unique fermented tang.
RECIPES_CARD5_INGREDIENTS: 4 tbsp fermented soup mix, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp water, sesame seeds.
RECIPES_CARD5_STEPS: Mix soup mix, oil and water to form a smooth paste. Spread very thinly onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake at 180°C for 8-10 minutes until crispy.
RECIPES_CARD5_SERVING: Perfect with hummus or as a crunchy topper for salads and soups.

STORY_HERO_TITLE: A fermented tradition, reimagined for everyday kitchens
STORY_HERO_DESC: Ella’s Pantry brings the warmth of traditional tarhana into modern Swedish homes — simple, naturally fermented and ready in minutes.
STORY_WHY_DESC: Tarhana has been made for generations as a way to preserve simple ingredients and turn them into something warm, filling and full of character. We wanted to introduce this tradition to Sweden in a way that feels natural for modern everyday life: easy to prepare, made with care, and simple to keep in the pantry.
STORY_SPECIAL_DESC: Tarhana is mixed, fermented, dried and crumbled before it ever reaches the kitchen. That slow process gives it its warm, savory flavor and gently tangy finish. At home, it only needs water, a few minutes of simmering and your favorite toppings.
STORY_SPECIAL_CARD3_DESC: A warm meal without a long cooking process.
STORY_PROMISE_DESC: Our goal is to make tarhana easy to discover without losing what makes it special: fermentation, warmth, simplicity and everyday comfort.
STORY_FINAL_DESC: Start with the classic soup, then explore more ways to use it.
HEALTH_SUBTITLE: Made with yogurt, grains, vegetables and herbs — slowly fermented for flavor, then dried for everyday convenience.
HEALTH_INSIDE_COPY: Our tarhana is made with yogurt, grains, tomatoes, peppers, chickpeas, mint and thyme — simple ingredients transformed through fermentation.
HEALTH_WHY_FERM_COPY: Fermentation gives tarhana its warm, savory depth and gently tangy character. It is part of what makes tarhana different from an ordinary soup mix.
